messages.Text: as a HIP, when i acknowledge the consent notify, is acknowledgement an array like the HIU one?

hits.summary: This is ABDM HIE-CM API called by HIP to acknowledge the notification sent when a consent request is approved/revoked/expired by the patient.
hits.title: POST /api/hiecm/consent/v3/request/hip/on-notify

spec.description: This API is called by HIP as acknowledgement to notification of consents, in cases of consent approval, revocation and expiration. Notified by CM earlier via Gateway API - /api/v3/consent/request/hip/notify

parameters.description: Unique UUID for track the end to end request transaction
parameters.name: REQUEST-ID

parameters.description: Actual time of the request was initiated, ISO 8601 represents date and time by starting with the year, followed by the month, the day, the hour, the minutes, seconds and milliseconds
parameters.name: TIMESTAMP

parameters.description: Suffix of the consent manager to which the request was intended
parameters.name: X-CM-ID

schema.description:
In the request body, either ‘acknowledgement’ or ‘error’ must be included.

  1. Incase of success scenario,acknowledgement is mandatory and error is optional
  2. Incase of failure scenario,error is mandatory and acknowledgement is optional
  3. response is mandatory object in both the cases

consentId.description: The consent artefact id. Should be valid UUID. Allows alpha numeric character and special characters like "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$";

status.description: The status of the notification.  Allows alpha numeric character and special characters like "^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-@,. \":/]{0,255}$"

error.description: The error code and message, if any occurred.

code.description: ABDM-1001 - No data found. May be returned either bare (`ABDM-1001`) or with a trailing ": " separator (`ABDM-1001: `); match on the code itself and tolerate the separator.

response.description: The request id is from the /consent/request/hip/notify callback

requestId.description: The requestId that was passed. it must be in Alpha numeric and - in middle and Allows alpha numeric character and special characters like "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}"

error.message: RequestId cannot be NULL or Blank
Invalid status, Please provide a valid status
Invalid ConsentId, Please provide a valid ConsentId

error.description: The error code and message, if any occurred.

code.description: The error code. May be returned either bare or with a trailing ": " separator; match on the code itself and tolerate the separator.
900901 - Unauthorized. May be returned either bare or with a trailing ": " separator; match on the code itself and tolerate the separator.

description.example: Invalid Credentials. Make sure your API invocation call has a header: 'Authorization : Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN' or 'Authorization : Basic ACCESS_TOKEN' or 'apikey: API_KEY'

error.description: The error code and message, if any occurred.

code.description: ABDM-1001 - No data found. May be returned either bare (`ABDM-1001`) or with a trailing ": " separator (`ABDM-1001: `); match on the code itself and tolerate the separator.
900900 - Unclassified Authentication Failure. May be returned either bare or with a trailing ": " separator; match on the code itself and tolerate the separator.

description.example: Access failure for API: /hiecm/api/v3, version: v3 status: (900900) - Unclassified Authentication Failure

code.description: ABDM-1024 - Dependent service unavailable. May be returned either bare (`ABDM-1024`) or with a trailing ": " separator (`ABDM-1024: `); match on the code itself and tolerate the separator.
